BrochureContent.Content:
***SECOND FLOOR / CORNER POSITION / BALCONY / PRIVATE ALLOCATED PARKING / GATED DEVELOPMENT / B RATED***
 
KELLY BRADSHAW are delighted to introduce Apartment 4, Block Milner's Square, Santry, Dublin 9.

Milner's Square is a gated, modern residential complex, with the Hanly Group behind the development, construction commencing in 2006. The property benefits from an impressive B energy rating, a great feature for buyers looking to avail of a green mortgage, subject to lender criteria.
 
No.4 is a bright and very well presented one bedroom apartment, perched on the second floor and offering comfortable accommodation, a lovely private balcony, allocated parking and a really convenient location in the heart of Santry.
 
From the moment you step inside, the apartment feels bright and welcoming. The hallway leads through to the main living accommodation, where the living-room, dining area and kitchen come together to create a lovely open space. There is plenty of room here for relaxing at the end of the day, having friends over for dinner or simply enjoying a quiet evening at home.

The living and dining area is particularly nice. The large corner dual-aspect windows bring in lots of natural light and look out over the internal courtyard and very well-maintained development, giving the room a lovely outlook and a real feeling of space. From here, doors open onto the private balcony, which is a great addition to the apartment. It is the kind of space you will find yourself using far more than you expect, whether that is sitting out with your morning coffee, enjoying some fresh air in the evening or simply having the doors open on a warm summer's day.

The kitchen is positioned just off the dining area and is fitted with a good range of wall and floor units together with integrated appliances and plenty of workspace. The warm timber flooring continues through the main living accommodation and adds to the comfortable feel of the apartment. The property is also heated by gas-fired central heating, offering efficient and comfortable heating throughout.
 
The double bedroom is a good size and benefits from built-in storage and a large window, making it a lovely retreat at the end of a long day. Completing the accommodation is the bathroom, a lovely modern space that is nicely finished with tiled flooring, hand basin W.C and a shower enclosure.
 
The location is a big part of the appeal here. Milners Square is tucked away in a mature and established part of Santry, while still being close to pretty much everything you could need. For everyday shopping, cafés, restaurants and a trip to the cinema, Omni Shopping Centre is just a short distance away, with a great choice of shops and places to eat all under one roof.

For weekends, there is plenty to enjoy locally too. Santry Demesne is nearby and is a lovely place to get out for a walk or a run, with its mature trees, open green spaces and walking paths. The park also has a children's playground, making it a great spot for families, while those who enjoy keeping active are well catered for with a number of sporting and fitness facilities in the surrounding area.

Santry is also extremely well connected. There are regular Dublin Bus services along the Swords Road, with routes providing easy access to Dublin City Centre, Drumcondra and Dublin Airport. The No. 16 is particularly convenient, travelling from the airport through Santry and into the city, making this an excellent location for anyone who commutes or travels regularly. For those who drive, the M1 and M50 are also easily accessible, while Dublin Airport, DCU and Beaumont Hospital are all within easy reach.

Another very practical benefit is the allocated parking space, giving residents the convenience of having their own designated parking within the development, something that is always high on the list for apartment buyers.

For a first-time buyer, an investor or anyone looking for a comfortable home with excellent transport links and plenty of amenities close by, Apartment 4, Block Milner's Square is a very appealing option. Bright, practical and easy to live in, it comes with the added bonus of a private balcony, lovely outlook, gas central heating, allocated parking and the benefit of a B energy rating, all in a location that makes day-to-day life just that little bit easier.

 Viewing is highly recommended to appreciate all that it has to offer.
